title: Habitat II
overview:
About Habitat II and NIFTY-Serve

1. To use this product, you need a Sega Saturn Keyboard, a Sega Saturn Modem (sold separately), and a telephone line.
2. This product is dedicated communication software for "Habitat II", an extended service of NIFTY-Serve. Membership in NIFTY-Serve is therefore required to use it.

Habitat II is an online virtual world run by Fujitsu on NIFTY-Serve. You take on an animated avatar and move through Elysium, a town set on an island of beaches, streets and wooded hills, meeting other members who are logged in at the same time and talking with them in real time.

- Graphical online community for NIFTY-Serve members
- Keyboard text entry, with Shuttle Mouse support
- Memory backup support

Habitat IIならびにニフティサーブについて

1.この商品をご利用いただくには、セガサターンキーボード、セガサターンモデム(別売)、ならびに電話回線が必要です。
2.この商品は、ニフティサーブの拡張サービス「Habitat II」のための専用通信ソフトです。このため、ご利用いただくにはニフティサーブへの入会が必要です。
